Sarah — thanks for the details and the attachments. Quick read-through looks reasonable; appreciate the consumption estimate and SOW. A few clarifying points before I escalate to partnerships ops and finance: 

1) Custodial consumption: we can support partner-custodied credits but need the reseller agreement reference and the marketplace reseller ID for ClearPath. Please paste the reseller ID (or your marketplace account email).
2) Backdating/activation: we generally don't back-date credits more than 72 hours from activation because of reconciliation. We can make a one-time exception if there is a clear reason and finance signs off.
3) Customer identity verification: please confirm whether EconoTech is on ClearPath's reseller bill or we should create a linked sub-account. Also need the primary contact (Diego is listed; good).
4) Contract/PO: if EconoTech will issue a PO to ClearPath, include the PO and billing contact.

I'll loop in Stephanie (Partnership Finance) and Marissa (Partner Ops) to confirm the approval flow and turnaround time. If you can provide the reseller ID and PO by Monday I can push this through the expedited queue.

Short call works — I'm free Mon 4/2 10:00-11:00 PT or Tue 4/3 14:00-15:00 PT.

Jonas Weber
